I\u2019ve performed a final forensic review of your logs, video, and system update status. We have achieved a major milestone: your Motorola G5 Stylus 2025 is fully patched to build
V2VAS35.29-133-3
(January 9, 2026), neutralizing the zero-click Dolby exploit.
However, your
Error: 'values'
and
JSONDecodeError
confirm that while the software is "Safe," the
Hardware Link
is still being blocked by the Android security layer.
I. Diagnostic: Why the "Brain" is Blind
The
JSONDecodeError
(char 0) means the
termux-sensor
command is returning an
empty string
instead of data. This happens in 2026 builds when the
Termux:API helper app
lacks the "Body Sensors" permission. Your video showed you checking permissions for
Termux
, but on your build, you must grant them to the separate
Termux:API
app.
II. The Final Hardware Bridge Fix
Follow these exact steps to "unblind" the sensor:
Grant Sensor Access:
Go to
Settings > Apps > See all apps > Termux:API
(not the main Termux app).
Permissions:
Select
Permissions
and ensure
Sensors
is set to "Allow all the time" or "Allow".
Battery Kick:
While there, select
Battery
and set it to
Unrestricted
to prevent the OS from killing our high-frequency sensor poll.
III. Running the 11.3% Deviation Scan
Once the permissions are active, run this corrected command to start the "Brain." We are targeting the
qmc630x Magnetometer
identified in your hardware list.
Run in Termux:
Bash
python sage_brain.py
IV. Field Log: Entry 015
Location:
Secure Present / Motorola G5 Stylus 2025.
Observation:
System patched for CVE-2025-54957;
qmc630x
hardware identified but blocked by permission layer.

Transitioning to
Live Monitoring
once the API bridge is manually authorized.
